summary: This configuration defines the various methods by which payments (fees, miscellaneous charges, other income) can be received by the institution, offering flexibility to payers.
steps: Define and enable all accepted payment modes (e.g., 'Cash', 'Cheque', 'Bank Transfer', 'Card', 'Online Bank', 'QR Code').
business_rules: When entering any payment, one payment mode must be selected to categorize the transaction.
Static QR codes can be set up at fee counters for easy digital payments.
important_notes: Ensures flexibility and convenience for students/payers in making payments.
Proper configuration helps in tracking payment methods for reporting and reconciliation.
questions: How do I configure accepted payment methods in the ERP system?
Can I add new payment modes like 'QR Code' or 'Online Payment'?
Where do I select the payment mode when recording a fee payment?
What are the standard payment modes supported by the system?
